model_revision_note: Installed local snapshot does not declare an immutable upstream revision; no revision inferred.
objective: Full-vocabulary causal cross-entropy for the single correct answer token
supervision: E1 endpoint gold answers; no A/P consistency or C/F preservation loss
sample_weighting: Equal A/P/C/F mass, equal source mass within class, aggregate both endpoints onto unique inputs
implementation_differences: One-token clinical answer SFT, original DoRA magnitude/direction parameterization unchanged
hyperparameter_selection: Single configuration fixed before development/test; no test selection
training_cost_scope: Training loop including tokenization; excludes model loading and evaluation
scoring_policy: All pair views plus all dynamically visited natural/interference path nodes; no gold labels used to choose nodes.
timing_scope: Prompt lookup and scorer callback only; model loading and training are excluded. Cached validation has no model inference cost.
inference_cost_scope: Unique-input evaluation, including pair inputs and visited dynamic-path inputs
